criteria: Only a new private payload contract: canonical public Command and original full binding reused; no loader/catalog/public changes in author source.

Exact pending-only three-field candidateId/commandSha256/status result for all scopes; reject saved/committed/approved/auto_committed or extra effect claims. Digest binds entire command including scopes and idempotencyKey. Receipt shape is not persistence or approval proof.

Trusted selected conversation client required for client scope, UUID correlation case-insensitive; no model tenant/actor/owner/admin/sourceKind authority. Nonclient arguments clientId null. Full same-tenant public scopes structural only.

Content/key trim with UTF16 4000/120 ceiling and reject overflow, no silent truncate. Default/blank/user_private scope personal, unknown scope reject. Key logical nullable, no copied storage-key derivation.
Finite positive numeric TTL min365 retains fractions; nonpositive/null/absent null; wrong scalar types refuse, no ambient clock or expiry computation.
Raw/context/command/result closed inert JSON; getters/proxies/toJSON/coercion are not invoked. Detached snapshot return at every validated boundary.
Canonical source readonly preservation; old tests unchanged, focused adversarial checks retain every failure/preimage; native/source producer remains unrun.
explicitCompatibilityChanges: Unknown scopes refused instead of personal fallback.
Client intent without trusted client refused instead of personal fallback.
Oversized text/key refused instead of truncation.
Wrong typed TTL refused instead of ignored.
Pending personal proposal differs from legacy same-call auto-commit; source adapter remains missing.
policy: Approved active user_admin/capiro_admin self-review exception unchanged; no new grant predicate or mandatory different reviewer.
limits: No current visibility/wall, broker/source authorization, durable candidate persistence, deduplication, restart/idempotency execution, or runtime acceptance.
No source body copied/imported/executed; no providers/SQL/native/network.
